artifact.note: The artifact is the model card the platform publishes and is checksum-addressed. This completion document is stored beside it and never inside it, so every previously published hash remains valid.

identity.name: Lettuce Earth fresh yield · per-area light-limited model (v3)
identity.task: Earth fresh shoot mass per plant, mediated by fresh yield per square metre
identity.servesAlongside: lettuce-earth-growth-v2 (byte-identical, still callable, still serving its 232 % external failure as the record that motivated v3)

purpose: Predict lettuce fresh mass per plant and per square metre from thermal time, temperature and daily light integral, with plant density entering through an explicit per-area identity.
intendedUse: Bounding how light integral and density move yield per square metre, and comparing a vertical-farm configuration with a horizontal one at equal photon supply.
notIntendedFor: Operational forecasting: 41.6 % MAPE on the independent Touliatos study against a 30 % criterion fixed in advance. The artifact records this and the platform must not present it as validated.
Densities above the declared ceiling (~200 plants/m2), where per-area yield is not learned but only divided.
Any cultivar other than Batavia Othilie: cultivar is not a feature.

features.name: dailyLightIntegral
features.unit: mol m-2 d-1, computed from PPFD and photoperiod

trainingData.hashBasis: SHA-256 of data/processed/lettuce_earth.csv. This value is corroborated rather than merely asserted: the v3 artifact records the same digest in its own trainingDataSha256 field, written by the training run.

split.note: Reported alongside a six-treatment independent cross-campaign interval check.

uncertainty.statement: Conformal residual quantiles on the log target, 5th and 95th percentile. Out-of-fold coverage 0.899 on the same predictions the quantiles come from, which the artifact itself labels descriptive rather than independent evidence; the independent cross-campaign check covers 6 of 6 treatment means.
uncertainty.artifactKind: conformal residual quantiles on the log target (5% / 95%)

limitations: Fresh yield per square metre is higher in the training system (non-limiting CO2, optimal temperature, plant factory) than in an ambient-CO2 greenhouse, so an upward bias remains.
Density enters only through the per-area identity; the model does not learn how density changes per-area yield, and refuses above ~200 plants/m2 for that reason.
Cultivar is not a feature. Batavia Othilie (training) differs from Baby Cos and Green Oak (development) by 63% in the external study, which no recalibration can represent.
The light response is monotonic; the development data are not.
Root-zone temperature is required by the model and is not reported by either external study, so it is assumed equal to air temperature in both checks.
Earth only, within the declared domains, and not validated for harvest forecasting.

outOfDomainBehaviour.mechanism: The artifact's `domain` block is enforced before scoring; a request outside it is refused with the field and range named rather than extrapolated, and a transcriptomic model rejects a partial expression vector instead of zero-filling.
